CookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
CookiePolicy.p1: Welcome to HomeLink 2.0. We uphold transparency in how we collect and process your information. This Cookie Policy explains how the HomeLink 2.0 platform ("we") uses cookies and similar technologies to recognize you when you visit our platform, maintain authentication sessions, and improve your property search and transaction experience.
CookiePolicy.p2: Our use of cookies is aligned with the Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP) and global privacy standards to ensure the security of your data.
CookiePolicy.p3: Cookies are small text files placed on your computer, tablet, or smartphone device when accessing a website. Cookies are widely used to make websites work efficiently, remember user preferences (such as login status or property search filters), and provide analytical information to site operators.
CookiePolicy.p4: HomeLink 2.0 uses several categories of cookies to operate the platform optimally:
CookiePolicy.essential_desc: Strictly necessary for you to navigate the platform, log into user accounts, and use property transaction security features.
CookiePolicy.functional_desc: Remember choices you make (such as language, search region preferences, or dashboard status) to provide a personalized experience.
CookiePolicy.perf_desc: Collect anonymous information about how visitors use our site (for example, which property pages are visited most often) for system speed optimization.
CookiePolicy.security_desc: Support the "Verified Property" system to prevent CSRF attacks, bots, and unauthorized access to agent/owner features.
CookiePolicy.purpose_1: Maintain user session authentication status when moving between dashboard pages.
CookiePolicy.purpose_2: Store property search criteria and temporary favorite properties.
CookiePolicy.purpose_3: Improve system performance and reduce page load time (caching).
CookiePolicy.purpose_4: Ensure anti-fraud protection on property survey bookings.
CookiePolicy.manage_1: Most web browsers automatically accept cookies. However, you can change your browser settings to decline cookies or notify you when a cookie is being sent.
CookiePolicy.manage_2: Please note that if you choose to disable or reject essential cookies, some parts of the HomeLink 2.0 platform (such as account login, saving favorite properties, or the owner dashboard) may not function properly.
CookiePolicy.changes_1: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect technological, legal, or operational changes to our platform. Updates will take effect immediately upon publication on this page.
CookiePolicy.contact_1: If you have any questions or concerns about the use of cookies on our platform, please contact our legal team:
CookiePolicy.contact_info:
Data Protection Officer / HomeLink 2.0 Legal Team
Email: legal@homelink.id
Phone: +62 21 555 1234
Address: HomeLink Tower 18th Floor, South Jakarta, Indonesia

While we strive to keep the information up to date and correct through independent verification teams (surveyors), we make no representations or warranties of any kind, express or implied, about the completeness, accuracy, reliability, suitability or availability with respect to the website or the information, products, services, or related graphics contained on the platform.
Disclaimer.p2: Although HomeLink 2.0 implements a "Zero Ghost Listing" policy and conducts field verifications, property market dynamics can change rapidly. Prospective buyers and tenants are still advised to conduct their own due diligence, perform physical checks, and verify the validity of certificates and legal documents with the relevant authorities before making financial transactions.
Disclaimer.p3: Content on the HomeLink 2.0 platform should not be construed as professional legal, tax, investment, or financial advice. You should consult a licensed professional (such as a notary, legal consultant, or financial planner) before making financial decisions or signing a property sale and purchase agreement.
Disclaimer.p4: Our platform may contain links to third-party websites (such as payment gateway partners or certification service providers). RefundPolicy.title: Refund Policy
RefundPolicy.p1: At HomeLink 2.0, the satisfaction of premium service users (such as verified agent features, featured listing ads, and Pro SaaS coupons) is our priority. This policy sets out the terms and conditions for submitting a refund request.
RefundPolicy.p2: You can cancel your HomeLink Pro subscription plan at any time through the Account Settings Dashboard. After cancellation, you will not be charged in the next billing cycle, and premium service access remains active until the end of the current period.
RefundPolicy.guarantee_desc: New annual subscription purchases are entitled to a 100% money-back guarantee if requested within the first 14 days from the transaction date.
RefundPolicy.onetime_desc: Listing highlight (boost) fees or scheduled professional photography services are non-refundable once processed/scheduled.
RefundPolicy.p3: To submit a refund claim, please email billing@homelink.id including the Invoice Number and Reason for Request. Approved funds will be refunded to the original payment method within 5-10 business days.
